Hi, you can find detailed information in the [product_name] manual, Section 4. As mentioned earlier, [product_name] Soft Comfort also provides helpful resources. If you do not have this software, a demo version is available for download at [url]. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: A user unfamiliar with [product_name] programming seeks guidance on the function blocks within FBDs. Responses recommend using [product_name] Soft Comfort software, especially its simulation and conversion features, to facilitate understanding. It is noted that missing configuration details make analysis harder. Reference is made to official manuals and demo versions as useful supplementary materials for new users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear explanations for function block definitions in [product_name] programs, as well as readily accessible resources. They value tools and documentation that help ease the learning process and provide simulation or visualization capabilities.
